mechanism: Torsemide-induced hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia may impair bisphosphonate efficacy and increase risk of atrial arrhythmias; risedronate requires adequate hydration which may be compromised by loop diuretic use.
action: Monitor electrolytes (potassium, magnesium, calcium) regularly; ensure adequate hydration and upright posture with risedronate; consider potassium-sparing alternatives or supplementation if concurrent use necessary.
